title: drynaria angustata
intro: Drynaria angustata, commonly known as Chinese Tuckahoe or Chinese Leavening, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae and is native to East Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Drynaria angustata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as polysaccharides, flavonoids, and alkaloids. Additionally, studies have shown that the plant's bioactive constituents exhibit anti-tumor and anti-viral activities, further supporting its medicinal value.
